_source: findings/21_edge_kong_authz.md section 5 (Kong-lite spec): 'username = merchant API key (rzp_live_.../rzp_test_..., regex ^rzp_(\w{4})_(\w{14})$), password = key secret'. Key ids below embed the merchant id (14 chars, matches the regex's \w{14} group and the merchant_id CHAR(14) column) so a request's key id trivially maps back to a merchant_id without a second lookup table.
_secret_note: The SECRET half of each key is NOT in this file (this is seeds/, not secrets/) -- it lives in secrets/merchant_arena_m{1,2,3}_secret.txt (generated fresh per-arena by secrets/gen-secrets.sh) and is looked up by 'secret_file' below at kong-lite boot. Do not add real secret VALUES to this file.
